Get ready to be swept away in a whirlwind of adrenaline-pumping quests, where danger and discovery await them at every turn.

programme.title: Eliot Kid
programme.desc: When a tooth falling out turns into a hunt for the “giant mouse”, when the city’s sewers transform into Indiana Jones’ white rapids or when a trip to the toilets becomes an expedition to a haunted house, well then you’ve entered the wonderful world of Eliot Kid!

programme.title: Sprinter Galore
programme.desc: The good-hearted Sprinter Galore is back at his home planet, battling evil villains bent.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie seeks shelter from an approaching thunderstorm in a cave under a tree. But when he hears a strange noise from the inside, Rookie tries to retreat quietly but runs straight into Mama Fox, who growls at him to protect her baby inside the cave. Rookie moves aside and decides to leave despite the rain, when suddenly lightning strikes, setting the tree on fire. Immediately, Rookie uses his robo-arms as a water hose to extinguish it and save the little fox family.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends

programme.title: Pincode
programme.desc: Barry is leading the team to find a new species! When they find out they're looking for new plants, the team isn't very excited at first. programme.title: The Journey Home
programme.desc: This story is about Mick, a sleeping chironomid. Insects are taken up into space for use in experiments by humans. An epic space adventure of Mick and his friends of their journey back home to Earth!

programme.title: Construction Squad

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie seeks shelter from an approaching thunderstorm in a cave under a tree. But when he hears a strange noise from the inside, Rookie tries to retreat quietly but runs straight into Mama Fox, who growls at him to protect her baby inside the cave. Rookie moves aside and decides to leave despite the rain, when suddenly lightning strikes, setting the tree on fire. Immediately, Rookie uses his robo-arms as a water hose to extinguish it and save the little fox family.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The Local Knowledge crew heads to Catalina Island off the coast of Southern California to participate in the 2024 War Heroes On Water tournament. This event offers a unique opportunity for the sport fishing community to create meaningful connections with our nation's heroes while raising awareness of the challenges they sometimes face when transitioning back to civilian life. With a little bit of luck and a lot of teamwork, Ali and Rush hope to put their veterans on a Bluefin tuna bite they won't forget!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Rush takes up an invite from good friend and fellow guide Jared Cyr to sight fish for barracuda and bonefish in the shallow waters of the Florida Keys. Meanwhile Rush's boat takes a break from charter fishing to get a new Seakeeper RIDE system installed.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: After a great trip fishing the flats, Rush returns the favor and extends an invite to friend Jarred Cyr fishing offshore. programme.title: Local Knowledge

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: 82 year old Navy veteran with more than 2.7 million TikTok followers, Patriotic Kenny talks of how he helps other vets through him gifting mobility scooters to fellow veterans in need.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun

That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range. - Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. - From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves. - As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field. - With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Winchester Life

With the development of the 350 Legend straight-walled cartridge by Winchester in 2019, a world of opportunities now existed in states like Ohio and Michigan. In this episode, with the 350 Legend in hand, three mature whitetails meet their maker, from the same blind, over the course of three seasons.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: In Episode 10 Boat Trader heads to central Texas to explore boating culture in the lone star state. Second only to Alaska in size, Texas is known as the place where everything is bigger. From big college football games to endless oil fields and vast wind farms, Texas is home to more than 30 million Americans. But the state is about more than just big oil, college football and cattle farms - it's also home to some of the best boating in the country. Boasting a myriad of waterways, boaters here enjoy hundreds of lakes, rivers and streams that provide recreational opportunities, abundant wildlife and plenty of fishing. From Austin Texas to San Antonio host Ryan McVinney and the Boat Trader crew explore the laid-back Texas lake life including boat up restaurants along the Colorado River, watersports in Austin and the history of the waterways throughout the region. Boat manufacturers highlighted in this episode are Tige Boats and ATX Surf Boats, two premium Texas-based wake boat brands known for their high-quality, cutting-edge vessels that come equipped with advanced wake shaping technologies and equipment ideal for water skiing, wake surfing and wakeboarding. There's even a wake surfing dog!

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life

After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: Could dinosaurs still walk the Earth? Deep in the Congo, legends say yes. In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green investigates the chilling reports of Mokele-mbembe, a dinosaur-like creature said to inhabit the remote swamps of the Congo Basin. We dive into real expedition footage, indigenous stories, and eyewitness accounts that all point to one shocking possibility: something ancient may still be alive in the heart of Africa. From early missionary reports in the 1900s to modern explorers risking their lives to chase the unknown, we piece together the long-standing mystery surrounding alleged dinosaur sightings in Africa. Whether you're into cryptids, paleontology, or just love a good wilderness mystery, this episode will have you questioning what’s really hiding in the unexplored corners of the Earth.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In 2003, Brett Mann and two friends were stranded in the flooded wilds of northern Australia. When Brett swam for help, he was taken by a massive crocodile. But the true horror came next. For nearly 24 hours, the crocodile returned—again and again—carrying Brett’s body, circling the tree where his friends clung to life. It wasn’t just hunting. It was showing them something. Was this predator defending its territory? Sending a message? Or acting with something more than instinct? - In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we examine the terrifying true story of Brett Mann—and ask: - When nature strikes back… is it ever personal?

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: The movie Jaws was inspired by a string of shark attacks... some in FRESHWATER! In this eerie episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green explores the shocking reality of sharks found in freshwater. From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we uncover true accounts from around the world that feel almost impossible. A fisherman off the coast of Chile is taken by a breaching whale. A diver vanishes into darkness and finds himself trapped inside the mouth of a humpback whale. Two kayakers are lifted from the water by something massive lurking just below the surface of the ocean. - These are not legends. These are real people telling their stories. - We also revisit one of the most powerful moments in the Bible. The story of Jonah. Scripture tells us that God prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah for a divine purpose. Could something like that still happen today? What does science say about surviving inside a whale? And are these modern encounters more than just coincidence?

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.desc: Episode 2 of Hunting Land Man keeps it rolling in the Mississippi woods. We’ve got some good buddies in camp this week, and it doesn’t take long for things to get interesting. One hunt ends in a tough miss, but we stay after it and bounce back with a longbeard hitting the dirt not long after. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Slade and the crew are finally able to catch up with these elk despite some pretty terrible weather conditions. It comes right down to the wire! Don’t miss it.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and his son take on the turkey woods for an afternoon hunt. Although the woods remained quiet, a tom soon snuck out of the woods and on the end of Bentley's barrel! After that Slade was able to help a client of his harvest his first turkey! And boy was it an action packed hunt! Jakes, hens, and tons of gobbles, This hunt is spectacular! Lastly, Slade introduces a property that we have already made a video on, but with just how amazing the land is, we had to include it! Floweree is the epitome of a sportsman's paradise!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade, Ryan and Bearcub take on the midwest! After some tough hunting, the group is able to make a move to get in position on a BIG midwestern gobbler! Bearcub was able to harvest him after working the bird for almost 45 minutes! Slade and Ryan also do some Pre-Deer season work, and establish where the fall food-plots will be!

programme.title: Ship Shape TV
programme.desc: During this episode of Ship Shape TV Essentials the SSTV team is at - John’s lake house on Tupper Lake, NY. They are checking out some of the damage done to John’s pontoon decking from freezing weather they received. John and the team are upgrading the material, and adding carpeting to the pontoon decking. We also get some information on SPX-Johnson bilge pumps and the ease of access they provide.

programme.title: Ship Shape TV
programme.desc: During this episode of Ship Shape TV Essentials the SSTV team is at - John’s lake house on Tupper Lake, NY, where they are tackling a new paint Job using Interlux’s paint specifically designed for aluminum hulls. John and the crew take us step by step on what takes to paint on aluminum hulls as well as some other tips from guest hosts.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Watch as Lori tags her first turkey of the season as well as the daily grind and comments from the office in McComb, Mississippi. The ladies in the office isn’t too fond of turkey season until it’s their turn.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade takes us through his new investment property, and breaks down - what’s involved in taking a raw land tract and creating extremely desirable turn-key - hunting properties. - Caleb and Slade double up on some Wilkinson County gobblers for Calebs first turkey - kill ever.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Missouri Project continues but this time it’s all about the turkey killing. Not only does Slade tag out in Missouri and Iowa, but a good family friend Kyle Hicks and Turkey Man Eddie Salter join in on a few hunts. Also, Slade does work on finding new 1031 tax properties and well as a little control burn.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Slade is staying busy busy around the house, lots of testing on summer plots with Deergro and Backwoods bachelor pad blend. Also, there locally he takes a quick look at the new 60 acres he and Ryan bought as an investment property. Then ends with a throwback hunt from under the barn.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: The "Trained Assassins" are back and it’s turkey season in the Midwest. In this first episode, Slade, Blake, and Ryan start in Missouri, run into some trouble, but end up getting it done on the first leg of the 2024 turkey tour.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: We are in Kansas again chasing monster whitetails. This season makes 15 years that we have been going to Kansas and this year was special. But first we had to show you this amazing listing in South Louisiana that’s a little different for the Hunting Land Man.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: U.S. Marine Jake Naylor recounts his harrowing service as an EOD tech in Afghanistan.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Vietnam war veteran Tim Smith recounts his time in Vietnam and surviving a direct hit by a missile.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Charter boat captain Mike Macko recounts his grueling life in the engine room aboard a U.S. Navy ship in the South Pacific theatre.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: U.S. Army veteran Victoria Phillips share her history of unimaginable trauma. - Viewer discretion is advised.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Follow TTHA President/CEO Christina Pittman and her husband Matt this week as they tag along side Dr. James Kroll for his annual deer day! This is a great opportunity to learn from one of the best. We are blessed to be able to share his knowledge with other like minded outdoor enthusiasts.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: John Sewell has played a huge part in the development of feeding Fortified Cottonseed 365 days a year. Laramie Barrett of Fortified Cottonseed joins John for a great weekend of hunting at his ranch in Uvalde, Texas. This is a great time for Laramie to get away from the office and see the first hand of how their product is performing.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Each year we get to spend time in camp with some of our best friends. Zach from Big & J gets some time in a blind while reflecting on what hunting in Texas means to him. Texas provides a wide variety of game, and chasing these creatures all across the state is some of the best times had.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: This week we are rolling along side the crew from Double T Outfitters. Management plays a huge role in every outfitters success every year. Bret and his team have a strong management plan in place and these guys had a blast with a group of out of state hunters.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Capt. Mike Avinon takes Blair off Naples for a variety of fish.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Capt. Blair tries for an upgrade off the coast of Naples.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Capt. Blair heads out by himself out of Cape Canaveral and gets a surprise at the end.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: The first half Blair heads out with Greggor Dornau of Starbrite Solutions, then in the second half goes fishing with Capt. Bobby lane for bass.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff venture deep into Maine’s backcountry with their buddy Chuck, ice fishing remote lakes only reachable by snowmobile. Their journey ends at the legendary “ghost trains,” a pair of abandoned locomotives that now rest as silent monuments to a forgotten logging era.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff wade into the flooded timber of the legendary Coca-Cola Woods, where mallards drop through the treetops in waves. Amidst echoes of calling and wingbeats, they experience one of America’s most iconic duck hunts.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff scour the rugged mountains of southern Arizona in search of the elusive Coues deer, known to hunters as the “Grey Ghost.” Through scorching sun and shifting winds, they test their skill and patience chasing one of North America’s most elusive big game animals.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: The Green Way team continue their African journey with hunts for both the majestic Kudu and elusive Golden Wildebeest. The experience comes full circle when the meat from these animals is donated to local schoolchildren, who receive not only fresh meals but also school supplies and sweets that light up the village.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Here's a look at the Realtree Road Trip crew's 2024 Franchi turkey shotgun setups. Michael Pitts and Bryan Brown get the Franchi shotguns unboxed and ready for the 2024 turkey season.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Michael Pitts is joined by competition caller and call-maker Anthony Virga, as well as Cole Barthel. It's the first hunt of the year for the Realtree Road Trips crew.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Gobblers are on fire in Georgia during the middle of April. Tyler Jordan is hunting with Turkeys for Tomorrow sweepstakes winners Jaryd and Kelli Hurst. Kelli is after her first turkey and just needs a little luck. Ole Miss Athletic Director Keith Carter also makes a visit to Realtree Farms to hunt.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: After a tough go at it in Oklahoma, Rigsby Stewart gets back to his home turf in East Georgia. This turkey gobbled his head off! Sweet redemption in the Georgia Pines!

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range. - Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. - From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves. - As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field. - With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nestled in the hills of Ohio just west of the Appalachians is a very special deer camp ripe with memories from deer season’s past. With the development of the 350 Legend straight-walled cartridge by Winchester in 2019, a world of opportunities now existed in states like Ohio and Michigan. In this episode, with the 350 Legend in hand, three mature whitetails meet their maker, from the same blind, over the course of three seasons.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the heart of the Zambezi Delta, a team of conservationists have overseen one of the largest range expansions of African lions in modern times. From a reintroduction of 24 lions in 2018, today the population is more than a hundred.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: For many protected reserves across Africa, the elephant populations are expanding, and this comes with a critical problem: what happens to the elephants when an area reaches carrying capacity? Dan Cabela investigates the growing problem, visiting Zimbabwe, Namibia and Angola to explore the future of elephant conservation.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: When the yellowtail at the islands refuse to play, it’s time to switch up the game plan. Ali and Rush pivot north of San Diego in search of hard-charging bluefin tuna during a multi-day mission aboard the 43’ custom ACI Catamaran "Killer Bee". Armed with the right crew, the right gear, and a never-quit mindset, the guys roll the dice on an overnight move—hoping to wake up to redemption and put a few quality bluefin on deck.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt. Justin Leake joins some old friends on board the Fall Line in hopes of scoring big in the Bay Point Billfish Open. This trip will test the limits of all the anglers as the skilled captain and crew do the impossible in hopes of bringing home the prize.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor launch out of Key Largo and fish their way up a creek filled with monsters.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - An Unforgettable Trip, South Lake, Part Two
programme.desc: This show was filmed in late October of 2019. Four months prior, in June of 2019, Tim Carnahan was diagnosed with Glioblastoma, Brain Cancer. According to Tim's medical team, his life expectancy could be between three months and 18 months. Fast forward to now, 2020; today's update is one we hoped would never come. With a heavy heart and tear-filled eyes, we share with you that Tim Carnahan has passed away after battling for close to 12 months. It only fits that the last words to pass his lips were I love you, Lory, and keep fishing. While his time on earth was cut short, the amount of joy he experienced and shared with others was genuinely tremendous and will never be forgotten. If you would like to help out in any way, lory and friends have put together a Go Fund Me page to ease the financial burden of medical bills and afford lory some time to greave and transition into life without Tim. We love you, Tim. Rest in peace, buddy.

programme.title: Galicia Enxebre Com David Arcay T2
programme.desc: El rio Navea es sin duda no de los rios de montaña que mayor concentracion de peces grandes que puede tener en Galicia. Pescaremos la parte mas alta donde los peces tiene algo menos de tamaño y en la parte baja de la montaña buscaremos las truchas trofeo.

programme.title: Con Arco Al Límite
programme.desc: Intentamos cazar conejos con arco tradicional, enfrentándonos a animales rápidos, lances inesperados y oportunidades que duran apenas unos segundos. Una modalidad donde los reflejos y la precisión son fundamentales. Aquí no hay margen para la improvisación, solo técnica e instinto.

programme.title: Lances no Rio Ara
programme.desc: Aratz e Denís são membros da equipa de lançamento e pesca à mosca do País Basco. No verão, os rios no País Basco secam e Torla ou Bujaruelo oferecem-lhes paisagens e trutas que os mantém completamente apaixonados pelo lugar.

programme.title: Así Somos: Proyecto Coturnix
programme.desc: Asi somos aborda unos de los proyectos mas importantes del sector cinegético de los ultimos años sobre el estado y conservación de la codorniz en la peninsula Ibérica.

programme.title: Carpfishing Exótico na Andaluzía
programme.desc: Encinarejo é uma das barragens mais bonitas desta comunidade, regada pelo rio Jándula, esta barragem de águas cristalinas é conhecida por ter as carpas mais explosivas e fortes da Andaluzia.

programme.title: Boreale, Vivências de Um Guia de Caça
programme.desc: Seguramente, sean cuales sean los episodios venideros de Boreale, este será el más excéntrico de todos. Nos vamos a la costa alicantina… ¡a por un atún! ¿Será capaz nuestro protagonista de luchar con un bluefin de más de 300 kg.

programme.title: Boreale, Vivências de Um Guia de Caça
programme.desc: Aprovechando el viaje con un grupo de cazadores españoles para cazar chanchos y antílope negro, Jordi nos revelará una de sus pasiones menos conocida: la caza de acuáticas. ¡Y qué mejor que Argentina para descubrir si es diestro o no con la escopeta.

programme.title: Play Pesca
programme.desc: Es andaluza, gran aficionada al carpfishing y pescadora en pareja. Hoy Susana Lara, también conocida como Lady Carpfishing, visita nuestro podcast con la caña y hablará con Odei Jainaga sobre su gran afición con la caña.

programme.title: Carpfishing Exótico na Andaluzía
programme.desc: Conhecido como o lago da Andaluzia, Iznajar é a maior albufeira desta comunidade e a pesca nestas águas é um desafio para qualquer pescador devido à diversidade das suas zonas de pesca, uma vez que se trata de uma albufeira com muitos locais diferentes.

programme.title: Buseu Project
programme.desc: O abutre-barbudo é uma espécie única de abutre que está em perigo de extinção na Espanha. Na década de 1980, sua população mal chegava a 20 casais. Hoje, mais de 200 casais nidificam, principalmente nos Pireneus.

programme.title: Ancares, Trutas Selvagens
programme.desc: O rio Sil é o verdadeiro protagonista deste dia de pesca. As águas frias e caudalosas deste rio mantêm uma população selvagem de trutas que leva os nossos protagonistas a esforçarem-se na deriva das suas ninfas.

programme.title: Con Arco Al Límite
programme.desc: Nos adentramos en plena berrea del ciervo entre montañas, bosques y el sonido de los machos en celo. Durante estas jornadas intentamos acercarnos a uno de los animales más emblemáticos de nuestra fauna, en un escenario donde cada movimiento cuenta.

programme.title: Lances Monteros En La Tierra Portuguesa
programme.desc: Mancha de 1500 hectáreas con cupo libre de reses donde participan monteros llegado de distintos países de Europa.

programme.title: Así Somos: Proyecto Coturnix
programme.desc: Asi somos aborda unos de los proyectos mas importantes del sector cinegético de los ultimos años sobre el estado y conservación de la codorniz en la peninsula Ibérica.

programme.title: Galicia Enxebre Com David Arcay T2
programme.desc: El rio Navea es sin duda no de los rios de montaña que mayor concentracion de peces grandes que puede tener en Galicia. Pescaremos la parte mas alta donde los peces tiene algo menos de tamaño y en la parte baja de la montaña buscaremos las truchas trofeo.

programme.title: Caçadores de Javalis T6
programme.desc: La pasión por el jabalí es también pasión por el perro y por las armas usadas en su caza. Allá donde haya jabalíes habrá cazadores volcados casi en exclusiva a esta especie, especializándose del mismo modo en razas de perros y en equipos adecuados.

programme.title: Trutas da Montanha em Cauterets
programme.desc: Aratz Zuazo continua a sua busca pelos melhores locais nos Pirenéus para a pesca de trutas. Depois da sua viagem anterior a Torla e Bujaruelo, desta vez viaja para Cauterets, em França.

programme.title: Quebec com Visão de Pássaro
programme.desc: José Boily es un entusiasta cazador y pescador canadiense de la provincia de Quebec que ha diseñado y protagonizado una serie de caza y de pesca que triunfa en Canadá y Francia en los últimos años. Probablemente la manera de cazar en la provincia de Quebec es la más similar a las técnicas europeas.

programme.title: Carnaza
programme.desc: Último capítulo de la temporada con la visita de un amigo, Enrique Martín, creador de contenido en redes sociales, al que nuestro chef le tiene preparada la receta más premium.

programme.title: Súper Mario Boss
programme.desc: Mario viaja hasta uno de los desiertos más secos del mundo, Atacama. Allí intentará cazar guanacos y vicuñas con las que elaborar excelentes recetas con su exquisita carne.

programme.title: Buseu Project
programme.desc: O abutre-barbudo é uma espécie única de abutre que está em perigo de extinção na Espanha. Na década de 1980, sua população mal chegava a 20 casais. Hoje, mais de 200 casais nidificam, principalmente nos Pireneus.

programme.title: A Muestra Con El 28
programme.desc: Nacho Olave y Aitor Iraola son dos apasionados cazadores con perro de muestra que tienen una particularidad en su forma de cazar, la de usar un calibre muy deportivo como es el 28. Becadas y codornices pondrán a prueba tanto sus escopetas del 28 como las líneas de setter que ellos mismos crían.

programme.title: A Muestra Con El 28
programme.desc: Nacho Olave y Aitor Iraola son dos apasionados cazadores con perro de muestra que tienen una particularidad en su forma de cazar, la de usar un calibre muy deportivo como es el 28. Becadas y codornices pondrán a prueba tanto sus escopetas del 28 como las líneas de setter que ellos mismos crían.

programme.title: De Viagem: Sal, a Ilha dos Mil Peixes
programme.desc: Uma equipa do canal Caça e Pesca viaja até à ilha do Sal, no arquipélago macaronésico de Cabo Verde. Uma ilha praticamente plana dedicada durante anos à extração do sal e que hoje é um destino turístico com praias maravilhosas de areia branca, águas quentes e cristalinas com recifes de coral.

programme.title: Mar de Tinta

programme.title: Quebec com Visão de Pássaro
programme.desc: José Boily es un entusiasta cazador y pescador canadiense de la provincia de Quebec que ha diseñado y protagonizado una serie de caza y de pesca que triunfa en Canadá y Francia en los últimos años. programme.title: Con Arco Al Límite
programme.desc: Intentamos cazar conejos con arco tradicional, enfrentándonos a animales rápidos, lances inesperados y oportunidades que duran apenas unos segundos. Una modalidad donde los reflejos y la precisión son fundamentales. Aquí no hay margen para la improvisación, solo técnica e instinto.

programme.title: O Neira, Uma Tarde de Julho
programme.desc: Com a mão de Alex Puente, iniciamos esta viagem pelas águas do rio Neira, no sul da província de Lugo. Iremos pescar neste ambiente, no meio da natureza, com a intenção de fazê-lo com mosca seca.

programme.title: Con Arco Al Límite
programme.desc: Nos adentramos en plena berrea del ciervo entre montañas, bosques y el sonido de los machos en celo. Durante estas jornadas intentamos acercarnos a uno de los animales más emblemáticos de nuestra fauna, en un escenario donde cada movimiento cuenta.

programme.title: Caçadores de Javalis T6
programme.desc: La pasión por el jabalí es también pasión por el perro y por las armas usadas en su caza. Allá donde haya jabalíes habrá cazadores volcados casi en exclusiva a esta especie, especializándose del mismo modo en razas de perros y en equipos adecuados.

programme.title: Boreale, Vivências de Um Guia de Caça
programme.desc: Seguramente, sean cuales sean los episodios venideros de Boreale, este será el más excéntrico de todos. Nos vamos a la costa alicantina… ¡a por un atún! ¿Será capaz nuestro protagonista de luchar con un bluefin de más de 300 kg.

programme.desc: Amanda y Emily comienzan sus aventuras en Key West, en los Cayos de Florida. Allí se lanzan a la búsqueda de grandes ejemplares de dorado (mahi-mahi) y practican apnea para capturar langostas en las cristalinas aguas de la región.

programme.title: Lances Monteros En La Tierra Portuguesa
programme.desc: En la comarca de Tras os montes se celebra una monteria entre amigos con el jabalí como pincipal protagonista.

programme.title: Pescando Com a Enchufáve
programme.desc: Dia de treino de inverno em Almenara aplicando lições de campeões: isco massivo de fundo com bolinhas de engodo e controlo exaustivo da cala.

programme.title: O Pescador Submarino Sustentável
programme.desc: Criado na ligação à natureza, embarcamos com David Foncueva numa viagem submarina pelo Cantábrico, onde a qualidade da pesca está acima da quantidade. O mar, a pesca e o respeito pelo ambiente são a nossa bandeira. Desfrutar e levar peixe fresco para casa é o objetivo desta aventura submarina.

programme.title: Twins Fish
programme.desc: Las gemelas emprenden una travesía de cientos de millas por mar abierto rumbo a las Bahamas. Una vez allí, disfrutan de las aguas tropicales de West End y se dedican a la pesca de fondo en busca de especies que habitan en las profundidades.

programme.title: Pescando Com a Enchufáve
programme.desc: Preparativos minuciosos na oficina caseira e deslocamento para o açude de Bellús para um concurso social por números consecutivos com companheiros de sociedade.

programme.title: A Muestra Con El 28
programme.desc: Nacho Olave y Aitor Iraola son dos apasionados cazadores con perro de muestra que tienen una particularidad en su forma de cazar, la de usar un calibre muy deportivo como es el 28. Becadas y codornices pondrán a prueba tanto sus escopetas del 28 como las líneas de setter que ellos mismos crían.

programme.title: Única Oportunidad
programme.desc: Antonio viaja hasta Islandia en busca de los caribues o renos salvajes. En paisajes de ensueño y con un viento huracanado la experiencia se convierte en todo un reto.

programme.title: O Pantanal, Domínio da Onça Pintada Ii
programme.desc: Juntamente com o nosso naturalista Manuel Fernández, iremos aprofundar a vida deste felino. Para tal, ficaremos alojados numa quinta de onde partem barcos que oferecem a oportunidade de avistar a esquiva onça-pintada.

programme.title: Trutas da Montanha em Cauterets
programme.desc: Aratz Zuazo continua a sua busca pelos melhores locais nos Pirenéus para a pesca de trutas. Depois da sua viagem anterior a Torla e Bujaruelo, desta vez viaja para Cauterets, em França.

programme.title: Caçadores de Javalis T6
programme.desc: La pasión por el jabalí es también pasión por el perro y por las armas usadas en su caza. Allá donde haya jabalíes habrá cazadores volcados casi en exclusiva a esta especie, especializándose del mismo modo en razas de perros y en equipos adecuados.

programme.title: Así Somos: One Health, Una Sola Salud
programme.desc: La salud de los seres humanos, los animales y la naturaleza forman un equilibrio único e inseparable. Esa es la premisa de la que parte el movimiento “One Health, Una Sola Salud”. A lo largo de este documental nos adentraremos en este enfoque global donde los cazadores juegan un papel clave.

programme.title: Única Oportunidad
programme.desc: Antonio Adán se embarca para cazar con su escopeta monotiro distintas especies de aves marinas. Una modalidad tradicional islandesa.

programme.title: Lances Monteros En La Tierra Portuguesa
programme.desc: Mancha de 1500 hectáreas con cupo libre de reses donde participan monteros llegado de distintos países de Europa.

programme.title: Súper Mario Boss
programme.desc: O Tapón do Darién é uma passagem sem estradas entre o Panamá e a Colômbia que consiste em selva densa, montanhas íngremes e vastos pântanos; o interesse de Mario centra-se nas profundezas do Oceano Pacífico em frente à costa.

programme.title: Play Caza
programme.desc: El mundo de las armas es complejo y poco conocido pero para desentrañar todos sus secretos invitamos a Play Caza a Antxon Lezaun.

programme.title: Buseu Project
programme.desc: O abutre-barbudo é uma espécie única de abutre que está em perigo de extinção na Espanha. Na década de 1980, sua população mal chegava a 20 casais. Hoje, mais de 200 casais nidificam, principalmente nos Pireneus.

programme.title: Ancares, Trutas Selvagens
programme.desc: O rio Sil é o verdadeiro protagonista deste dia de pesca. As águas frias e caudalosas deste rio mantêm uma população selvagem de trutas que leva os nossos protagonistas a esforçarem-se na deriva das suas ninfas.

programme.title: Súper Mario Boss
programme.desc: Argentina es el pais del asado por excelencia. Mario aprovecha la caza de distintas especies para asarlas al estilo argentino, maestros de la parrilla.

programme.title: Carnaza
programme.desc: Último capítulo de la temporada con la visita de un amigo, Enrique Martín, creador de contenido en redes sociales, al que nuestro chef le tiene preparada la receta más premium.

programme.title: Quebec com Visão de Pássaro
programme.desc: José Boily es un entusiasta cazador y pescador canadiense de la provincia de Quebec que ha diseñado y protagonizado una serie de caza y de pesca que triunfa en Canadá y Francia en los últimos años. Probablemente la manera de cazar en la provincia de Quebec es la más similar a las técnicas europeas.

programme.title: 180 Meets Idles
programme.desc: É difícil descrever a energia avassaladora do concerto dos IDLES no Vodafone Paredes de Coura 2024, mas foi exatamente o que se esperava: quase uma hora de mosh ininterrupto, salpicada com gritos de solidariedade política, nomeadamente com a Palestina. Poucas bandas conseguem atualmente provocar este tipo de reação numa multidão de dezenas de milhares de pessoas, por isso ficámos muito felizes por ter a oportunidade de conversar com Joe Talbot e Mark Bowen antes do concerto. Contaram-nos como o facto de serem politicamente interventivos pode materializar-se sob a forma de amor, e como a música, por si só, pode ser um motor de mudança positiva, mesmo quando não carrega uma intenção política explícita.

programme.title: Os Oito Dias que Definiram Roma
programme.desc: É neste dia de 32 aC que Caio Octávio terá ordenado o roubo do testamento do seu rival Marco António, e lido o seu conteúdo super controverso ao Senado de Roma.

programme.title: Roma, A Primeira Superpotência
programme.desc: Desde Rómulo e Remo até ao nascimento da República, este episódio explora as origens de Roma e os primeiros passos da sua conquista da Itália.

programme.title: Roma, A Primeira Superpotência
programme.desc: Roma e Cartago protagonizam uma luta decisiva pelo Mediterrâneo. Este episódio revela descobertas arqueológicas que mostram a dureza de um conflito que mudou a História.

programme.title: Alienígenas
programme.desc: Quando a Humanidade se prepara para fundar colónias noutros planetas, estará, simplesmente, a cumprir o seu futuro ou a regressar ao seu passado extraterrestre?

programme.title: Dominique

programme.title: Actos de Vingança

programme.title: American Pie - A Primeira Vez
programme.desc: Um adolescente tenta desesperadamente perder a virgindade, mas todas as suas tentativas saem falhadas.

programme.title: Poker Face

programme.title: A Rapariga no Comboio (2016)
programme.desc: Rachel fantasia com a vida aparentemente perfeita de um casal que vive do outro lado da linha do comboio que apanha diariamente. Quando, da janela, vê algo que a perturba, vê-se envolvida numa investigação a uma pessoa desaparecida.

programme.title: Pig - A Viagem de Rob
programme.desc: Um caçador de trufas que vive sozinho na região selvagem do Oregon tem de regressar ao seu passado em Portland, em busca da sua amada porca forrageira, depois de esta ter sido raptada.

programme.title: Mamma Mia: Here We Go Again!
programme.desc: Cinco anos passaram e Sophie prepara-se para a grande reabertura do Hotel Bella Donna, que irá reunir novamente toda a gente! Durante os preparativos, Sophie fica a conhecer melhor o passado da sua mãe.

programme.title: Harry Potter e a Câmara dos Segredos
programme.desc: Uma profecia antiga parece estar a concretizar-se quando uma presença misteriosa começa a perseguir pessoas nos corredores da escola de magia e a deixar as suas vítimas paralisadas.

programme.title: Bastille Day - Missão Antiterrorista
programme.desc: Em Paris, um agente da CIA une esforços com um carteirista para impedirem uma conspiração internacional. Numa frenética corrida contra o tempo, o duo apercebe-se que ambos se tornaram alvos a abater e que têm de confiar um no outro para vencer.

programme.title: Unstoppable (2024)
programme.desc: Gira em torno da vida do lutador Anthony Robles, que nasceu apenas com uma perna e ganhou um campeonato nacional em 2011 enquanto competia na Arizona State University.

programme.title: Missão: Impossível 2
programme.desc: Um agente secreto luta contra um espião renegado, que tem na sua posse um vírus mortal e ameaça espalhá-lo pela cidade de Sydney.

programme.title: Imparável
programme.desc: Frank é um engenheiro veterano de uma companhia ferroviária prestes a ser dispensado. Will é um maquinista recém-contratado, pouco motivado mas com noção do dever. Os seus destinos cruzam-se quando um comboio cheio de combustível e gás venenoso se dirige, desgovernado, a uma cidade.

programme.title: O Lado Negro
programme.desc: O agente da Interpol Russell Hatch testemunha a morte de um informante quando uma operação aparentemente rotineira dá errado. Anos depois, ele vê se protegendo o filho do informante de um grupo de gangues impiedosas envolvidas numa guerra total.

programme.title: Balas & Bolinhos o Último Capítulo
programme.desc: A vida continua difícil para Culatra, Rato e Bino. Mas tudo muda quando Tone, o homem do Mundo, regressa a casa para tentar salvar o pai, que está às portas da morte. E quando o reencontro acontece partem para a mais surpreendente das suas aventuras.

programme.title: Zoom in
programme.desc: Um olhar pelos bastidores dos filmes de maior sucesso de Hollywood.

programme.title: American Pie 2: O Ano Seguinte
programme.desc: A seguir às estranhas descobertas dos prazeres sexuais, os adolescentes separaram-se, foram para a universidade e estão à beira de entrar na vida adulta. No entanto, depois de um ano sem se verem, os rapazes alugam uma casa na praia e comprometem-se a tornar esse verão o melhor das suas vidas.

programme.title: Hollywood News Feed
programme.desc: As novidades, os gossips das suas estrelas favoritas de Hollywood.

programme.title: Oppenheimer
programme.desc: Passado na Segunda Guerra Mundial, o filme acompanha a vida de J. Robert Oppenheimer (Cillian Murphy), físico teórico que tinha a missão de conceber a primeira bomba atómica.

programme.title: Zoom in
programme.desc: Um olhar pelos bastidores dos filmes de maior sucesso de Hollywood.

programme.title: Evereste
programme.desc: Inspirado no caso verídico de uma expedição ao cume do Evereste. Uma história que terminou em tragédia, já que os alpinistas foram apanhados de surpresa por uma violenta tempestade de neve.

programme.title: The Creator
programme.desc: Contra o pano de fundo de uma guerra entre humanos e robôs com inteligência artificial, um ex-soldado encontra a arma secreta dos robôs para acabar com o conflito, uma IA na forma de uma criança.

programme.title: Harry Potter e o Prisioneiro de Azkaban
programme.desc: De regresso a Hogwarts, Harry Potter toma conhecimento de que o temível Sirius Black, o presumível assassino de seus pais, se evadiu da prisão.

programme.title: Togo
programme.desc: A história de Togo, o cão de trenó que liderou a corrida do soro de 1925, apesar de ser considerado pequeno e fraco demais para liderar uma corrida tão intensa.

programme.title: A Lenda de Tarzan
programme.desc: Tarzan trocou a selva pela vida civilizada e é agora conhecido como John Clayton e casado com Jane. Inesperadamente, é convidado a regressar ao Congo, como emissário do Parlamento, mas desconhe que está a ser usado num plano de ganância e vingança.

programme.title: Missão: Impossível 3
programme.desc: Noivo de Julia, Ethan Hunt saiu de cena optando pela formação a novos agentes. Porém, é chamado a uma última missão: abortar os planos dum traficante de armas.

programme.title: Uns Compadres do pior
programme.desc: A roupa suja lava-se em casa! O caos doméstico avizinha-se para o enfermeiro Greg Focker quando o seu sogro ordeiro e ex-agente da CIA lhe pede para conhecer os seus pais - uma mãe e um pai amplamente anti-convencionais.

programme.title: Perseguição sem Tréguas
programme.desc: Chance é o alvo de um perverso mercenário que utiliza veteranos de combate na penúria para entreter os seus clientes-milionários, sem nada que fazer, que se divertem a pagar meio milhão de dólares para caçar a presa mais aliciante de todas: o homem.

programme.title: Dogman
programme.desc: Um rapaz, maltratado pela vida, encontra a salvação através do amor dos seus cães. “Quando o homem está com problemas, Deus envia-lhe um cão.” – Alphonse de Lamartine.

programme.title: O Reino
programme.desc: Um terrorista detona uma bomba numa zona residencial americana em Riade (Arábia Saudita) e está em marcha um incidente internacional. Uma equipa do FBI é deslocada para o local, mas rapidamente se apercebe das dificuldades impostas pelas autoridades locais.

programme.title: American Pie, o Casamento
programme.desc: Quando dois jovens decidem casar, os seus amigos preparam-lhes uma despedida de solteiros de arromba.

programme.title: Hollywood News Feed
programme.desc: As novidades, os gossips das suas estrelas favoritas de Hollywood.

programme.title: Amor Polar
programme.desc: Um pai maníaco-depressivo tenta reconquistar a mulher, ao responsabilizar-se pelas duas filhas - jovens e espirituosas - que em nada lhe vão facilitar a vida.

programme.title: O Príncipe Volta a Nova Iorque
programme.desc: O monarca africano Akeem descobre que tem um filho há muito perdido nos Estados Unidos e deve regressar à América para conhecer este herdeiro inesperado e construir uma relação com ele.

programme.title: Eu Capitão
programme.desc: A história de um rapaz que, na companhia do primo, decide abandonar o Senegal para alcançar a Europa. Uma aventura por entre os perigos do deserto, do mar e das contradições humanas, na qual a esperança se transforma numa luta pela sobrevivência.

programme.title: Batman - O Início
programme.desc: Depois da morte dos pais, Bruce Wayne viaja pelo Mundo, à procura de meios para combater a injustiça e atormentar criminosos. São estas as origens da lenda de Batman e do aparecimento do Cavaleiro das Trevas, uma força do Bem em Gotham.

programme.title: No Limite do Amanhã
programme.desc: A Terra é invadida por uma impiedosa raça alienígena e o inexperiente major William Cage é arrastado para a linha da frente. Morre em poucos minutos, mas entra numa repetição temporal que o força a reviver o combate, vezes sem conta.

programme.title: Harry Potter e o Cálice de Fogo
programme.desc: No seu quarto ano em Hogwarts, o jovem feiticeiro Harry Potter é escolhido para participar num torneio importante, cujas provas são potencialmente mortíferas.

programme.title: Missão Impossível: Operação Fantasma
programme.desc: Acusado do atentado terrorista ao Kremlin, Ethan Hunt é renegado, bem como o resto da Agência, quando o Presidente inicia a «Operação Fantasma». Sem recursos ou apoios, Ethan tem de encontrar forma de limpar o nome da Agência e prevenir outro ataque.

programme.title: Hércules
programme.desc: Homem e mito, Hércules lidera um grupo de mercenários que tentam pôr fim a uma sangrenta guerra civil na Trácia e a devolver o trono ao rei legítimo. Uma alma atormentada desde que nasceu, Hércules tem a força de um Deus mas sofre como um ser humano.

programme.title: Muzzle
programme.desc: Quando descobre que o seu cão e parceiro foi morto, Jake Rosser mergulha num submundo sombrio para descobrir a verdade sobre quem poderá ser o responsável.

programme.title: Masha e o Urso
programme.desc: A Masha decide desistir da sua antiga vida e … desaparece.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: De certeza que gostas mesmo de histórias assustadoras? E se este tipo de histórias realmente te deixar sobressaltado? Ouve esta história clássica e depois não digas que não ficaste chocado.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Imagina se algum mega cérebro quisesse conquistar a Terra com recurso a monstros mecânicos?! Podes pensar que é uma piada, mas há tantas máquinas ao nosso redor que não há forma de sabermos se estamos mesmo seguros.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Todas as crianças gostam de videojogos! Todas elas gostam de destruir uns monstros antes de dormir. Tolik também gostava, até que os monstros, por vingança, decidiram atacá-lo mesmo a sério! Ou seria apenas um sonho.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Masha conta uma história sobre trovões e relâmpagos e o que pode acontecer se um relâmpago, de repente, te atingir no parque… enquanto desfrutas de um sumo de laranja.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Todos acham que é assustador ser pequeno porque há muitas coisas que não são acessíveis! Mas, na verdade, o nosso tamanho não interessa quando há alguém que se preocupa conosco e alguém com quem nós nos preocupamos….

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Qualquer criança tem medo de ouvir notícias sobre um certo acontecimento feliz - a chegada de uma nova irmãzinha. Ela pode vir estragar os teus brinquedos e roubar os teus doces. Mas, por outro lado, ela pode ser linda, amiga e ajudar-te em tudo.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Um animal alto como a girafa também tem os seus medos. Masha descobre que até as criaturas mais altas podem ser pequenas diante de problemas... e que até os mais pequenos podem superar grandes problemas.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Esta é uma história super assustadora sobre um palhaço estranho que, de repente, fica muito irritado e começa a assustar todas as crianças. O que aconteceu com o palhaço, afinal.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Esta história é sobre uma menina que tinha medo de tudo! Um dia, ela conheceu um menino que era fascinado por histórias de terror... E ficou muito feliz porque tremer de medo com um amigo ao seu lado era muito mais interessante e divertido.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Masha inventa o conto sobre um pequeno inseto, que vivia no bosque e tinha tanto medo do escuro que qualquer barulhinho o assustava! Até que o inseto percebeu que todas as coisinhas que se veem no escuro parecem espantosas e o medo não faz sentido.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Um menino tinha tanto medo da água que parou de tomar banho e transformou-se num porquinho. Todos os seus amigos fugiram dele com medo! No final, ele superou o seu medo, percebendo que a água pode ser segura e divertida.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Um menino perdeu a pá do seu trator de brincar e decidiu procurá-la numa fábrica de tratores abandonada. Lá, ele encontrou vários monstros e ficou aterrorizado... Até perceber que estava num cenário de filme e todos aqueles monstros não eram reais.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.desc: Rusty é um menino de 10 anos que vive na cidade de Sparkton Hills e, juntamente com de seu amigo Ruby – um tiranossauro robótico – e um grupo de roboz conhecidos como Bits, utiliza as suas capacidades em engenharia para encontrar peças e objetos eletronicos, inventar e reconstruir máquinas.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Era uma vez um menino que estava interessado em apenas duas coisas: livros sobre diferentes humanoides e doces. E então, enquanto lia um livro, ele ouviu um barulho estranho! Será que eram Humanoides? Será que eles existem mesmo?

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Nalguns países, há a tradição de se pedir às crianças que recitem poemas natalícios em voz alta, para as visitas. Algumas crianças ficam com tanto medo no momento de recitarem o poema que são incapazes de pronunciar uma única palavra.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Algumas pessoas acreditam em todo o tipo de superstições, como gatos pretos, vestir roupas do avesso, sonhos proféticos... Lucy era uma menina que acreditava tanto nesse tipo de coisas que até tinha medo de sair de casa para brincar com os amigos.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Semushka é um menino que teme todo o tipo de doenças e pragas. Ele vê doenças em tudo o que o rodeia, por isso tem sempre consigo um kit de primeiros-socorros que a sua avó lhe pôs na mochila. Para além disso, usa uma roupa especial de proteção.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Esta é a história de uma menina que tinha tanto medo de animais que era capaz de trepar a uma árvore só para se esquivar do encontro com alguns deles.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Era uma vez uma avó que tinha muito medo de não agradar ao neto. Uma vez ela tentou dar-lhe um tomate e ele atirou-o contra a parede! A avó ficou tão chateada que saiu de casa... E o neto ficou assustado ao ver-se de repente sozinho.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Masha explica por que não há motivo para ter medo de monstros, do escuro, de ir para uma escola nova, de trovoadas e de outras coisas que assustam os mais novos.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Esta é a história de Sima, uma menina que tinha medo de médicos. Uma vez, ela preparou um jantar de barro para as suas bonecas. Como a refeição parecia saborosa, Sima provou um pouco... Mas sentiu uma dor de estômago horrível que a levou ao hospital.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Era uma vez um menino que estava interessado em apenas duas coisas: livros sobre diferentes humanoides e doces. E então, enquanto lia um livro, ele ouviu um barulho estranho! Será que eram Humanoides? Será que eles existem mesmo?

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Era uma vez um menino que estava cheio de medo de mudar de escola porque achava que a outra escola teria professores de aparência monstruosa, aulas de educação física sem regras e rufias maldosos! Mas, na realidade, não havia nada a temer.

programme.title: As Histórias Espantosas da Masha
programme.desc: Semyon adorava a sua cadela, a Princesa. Um dia, a cadela fugiu para a floresta e Semyon foi atrás dela. Ele atravessou a floresta e acabou por se perder. Felizmente, um pastor guiou-o de volta a casa, onde a cadela já estava à sua espera.

programme.title: Dino Ranch

programme.title: Dino Ranch

programme.title: Masha Canções Infantis

programme.title: Masha Canções Infantis

programme.title: Masha Canções Infantis
programme.desc: Num passeio de bicicleta a Masha encontra três ovelhas: uma ovelha preta, uma branca e uma vermelha. Elas estão com pressa para chegar ao comboio na estação, e cada uma delas carrega três sacos de lã como presente para os seus donos e o seu filho, que é amigo das ovelhas.

programme.title: Masha Canções Infantis
programme.desc: Oh, está a chover, está a chover! A Masha não pode ir para o quintal com a sua bola, o Urso não pode lançar um avião no céu e o Coelho não pode jogar hóquei no campo. Mas se pegares num guarda-chuva e calçares umas galochas, as coisas podem tomar um rumo completamente diferente.

programme.title: Masha Canções Infantis
programme.desc: Acontece sempre alguma coisa interessante quando passamos tempo com o Tigre. Desta vez é um verdadeiro espetáculo na discoteca! Uma excelente forma, aliás, de apimentar a ida à casa do Urso: cantando e dançando com todas as forças.

programme.title: Masha e o Urso: As Canções da Masha

programme.title: Masha e o Urso: As Canções da Masha

programme.title: Sin Senos Sí Hay Paraíso
programme.desc: La pasarela de las jóvenes más bellas de la región se ha convertido en un campo de batalla. Los Marín apoyan a su hija Catalina (Carolina Gaitan), y Yésica Beltrán "La Diabla" (Majida Issa) está dispuesta a todo con tal de ver a su hija Daniela (Johanna Fadul) sea la nueva reina de la región. Yésica llega al evento disfrazada de su hermana y ha entrado en contacto con los miembros del jurado buscando la manera de sobornarlos para que favorezcan su votación hacia Daniela, Pero Catalina Marín se destaca no solo por su belleza sino por su intelecto. El Resultado de este certamen definirá el rumbo de sus vidas…Catalina Santana está amenazada Hernán Darío, pero la obsesión de Mariana (Stephania Duque) de descubrir de quien es la niña empuja a Catalina a afirmar que es hija de Hernán Darío. Catalina Marín duda de la paternidad de Hernán y hará todo lo que esté a su alcance para descifrar la identidad del verdadero padre de la hija de Catalina. No será una batalla fácil y Mariana hará todo lo posible para arrebatarle el amor de su vida a Catalina.Mientras se materializa la temible maldición de la Bruja Abigail, Catalina Santana (Carmen Villalobos) y sus amigas saben que sus hijas están en peligro. Adriana, la hija de Vanesa murió, al igual que Martina, la hija de Paola, y ahora Catalina deberá esforzarse para cuidar a su hija Mariana, mientras que Ximena cuida los pasos de su hija, Valentina. En esta batalla contra el mal tendrá muchos aliados, pero no faltan los enemigos….

programme.title: El Señor de los Cielos
programme.desc: Narra la historia de Aurelio Casillas (Rafael Amaya), un narcotraficante mexicano que desde pequeño pierde a su padre por lo que él y su hermano, Víctor Casillas (Raúl Méndez), se ven forzados a sobrevivir por si solos.

programme.title: Pasión de Gavilanes
programme.desc: Juan (Mario Cimarro), Oscar (Alfonso Baptista) y Franco Reyes (Michel Brown) son tres hermanos que tienen una hermana menor, Libia (Ana Lucía Domínguez). Libia se enamora de Bernardo Elizondo, un hombre adinerado que es dueño de un rancho y además padre de Norma (Danna Garcia) Jimena (Paola Rey) y Sariata Elizondo (Natasha Klauss). A pesar de la diferencia de edades, Libia queda embarazada pero un día el ya mayor hombre muere y ella estaba tan enamorada que se suicida. Sus tres hermanos creen que todo esto se debe a Bernardo así que ellos deciden vengarse de todos los Elizondo haciéndose pasar por trabajadores de la hacienda. Ya introducidos como trabajadores los tres hermanos conocen a las tres hijas de Bernardo Elizondo y ellos deciden que la mejor forma de vengarse es engañar a las tres hermanas tal y cómo Bernardo lo hizo con su única hermana Libia.

programme.title: WAGS
programme.desc: Uma discussão acesa e por resolver entre a Autumn e a Natalie está a pôr em risco a sua viagem. A tensão crescente entre as duas ameaça transformar o que deveria ser um momento de lazer numa fonte de discórdia e frustração, comprometendo o bem-estar de todos os envolvidos e a concretização dos planos iniciais.
